title: Ext-groups of graded comodules
summary: Let $Γ$ be a coalgebra over a field. There is a well-known covariant embedding of the category of graded $Γ$-comodules into the category of graded modules over the dual algebra $Γ^*$. We show that this covariant embedding preserves Ext-groups in a range of motivating cases, including in some cases like Steenrod algebras where the covariant embedding has otherwise bad homological properties and fails to preserve Ext-groups on the underlying ungraded categories.
